about: Prediction ledger (operator 11/07): before a result lands, each forecaster writes a concrete expected outcome. Scored after. Over time this shows, with numbers, whether Claude is too pessimistic and Argon too optimistic, and on which kinds of question each is reliable. Add Argon's forecasts verbatim as the operator relays them.

items.test: X3 trend-hold 'both' (floor at opening stop + off after +15 bp peak), session replay screen
items.expect: screen DROP or a delta within +-10 bp/day; does not reach confirm
small positive day delta (cuts the -70..-80 bp tail) but fewer than 60% of days better

items.test: X5 lock50 rerun on the fixed bypass, session replay
items.expect: DROP at the screen (the trade sim showed +0.11 bp at realistic latency)

items.test: H1 peer lead-lag rerun with later-only controls
items.expect: still FAIL on absolute net; lift vs same-name control moves toward zero

items.test: broker truth: week of 2026-11-09 net bp per round trip
items.expect: between -8 and 0 bp (same range as the last five weeks)
